candidate_state: planned from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, rustdoc with warnings denied, the optional opening-book feature, release and trainer Python tests, documentation and public-surface checks, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly native tests, package generation, metadata validation, and generated JavaScript contract checks passed. This release organizes and updates public documentation and adds reproducibility and audit contracts for training provenance, opening-book runs, gate observations, and WebAssembly package metadata. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.67.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The new provenance and observation contracts improve reproducibility and auditability but do not by themselves prove model quality or playing strength.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
The local Chrome browser test could not start because ChromeDriver 155 did not match installed Chrome 154; the hosted WebAssembly browser job remains a required release check.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
